frames.title: Choose which frames to show
frames.description:
Pick the frames Home Assistant should expose. Everything on a frame you untick — its calendar, chores, lists, and displays — is removed.

Leave them all ticked to follow the account, so a frame added later appears on its own.

profiles.title: Match people to Skylight profiles
profiles.description:
Pick the Home Assistant person behind each Skylight profile.

This is only used for "Up for Grabs" chores. Those belong to nobody, so Skylight insists on knowing who claimed one — whoever ticks the box gets the credit. Chores already assigned to a profile need no mapping.

abort.no_profiles: No Skylight family profiles were found on this account.
abort.no_frames: No Skylight frames were found on this account.

redeem_reward.name: Redeem reward
redeem_reward.description: Redeems a Skylight reward, spending the points it costs. The reward belongs to one family profile, so that profile is the one credited.

award_points.name: Award points
award_points.description: Gives a family profile reward points — the stars on the frame's chore chart. Target the profile's reward points sensor.

points.name: Points
points.description: How many points to move. Skylight rejects zero, so this must be at least 1.

deduct_points.name: Deduct points
deduct_points.description: Takes reward points away from a family profile. Skylight does not stop at zero: deducting more than the balance leaves it negative.

points.name: Points
points.description: How many points to move. Skylight rejects zero, so this must be at least 1.

add_recipe.name: Add recipe to grocery list
add_recipe.description: Adds a recipe's ingredients to the Skylight grocery list. Skylight reads them out of the recipe's own text, so they appear a few seconds after the action runs. Target the frame's default grocery list — it is the only list Skylight will add to.

recipe.name: Recipe
recipe.description: The recipe's name, as it appears in the Skylight app.
